title: Distinctness of Walsh characters
statement: For every $n\ge 0$, distinct subsets $S,T\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ define distinct Walsh characters on $\mathbb F_2^n$; equivalently, the map sending each subset to its character $x\mapsto(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ is injective.
